The '''Laud system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. The system contained at least one [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], which [[Lant Mining Corporation]] conducted gas mining operations.<ref name="FBS" />
